category: content negotiation (a non-strict comparison makes the last equally-rated candidate win, and lets a zero-rated one win at all); 30 files across 4 packages
issue: Our sales report endpoint can produce JSON, CSV and HTML and is configured to prefer them in that order, but a client that sends no Accept header, or sends Accept: */*, gets HTML back -- the last format the endpoint lists rather than the first. The catalogue endpoint, which lists CSV ahead of JSON, has the mirror image of the problem: plain curl with no Accept header gets JSON from it. Asking for one specific type explicitly still works. There is a worse version of this: a client that sends Accept: application/xml, which none of our endpoints can produce, gets a 200 with an HTML body instead of the 406 it should get.
